title: Spiritual Warfare
definition: Spiritual Warfare is the believer’s struggle against spiritual evil through faith, truth, prayer, repentance, and dependence on God.
summary: Spiritual Warfare is the believer’s struggle against spiritual evil through faith, truth, prayer, repentance, and dependence on God.
christFocus: Jesus has won the decisive victory and equips His people with the armor of God.

studySections.heading: Doctrine in Summary
studySections.content:
Spiritual Warfare recognizes spiritual reality while keeping God, not the spiritual realm, at the center. Warfare is real, but scripture keeps the focus on standing in christ rather than obsessing over darkness.

Scripture speaks soberly about angels, demons, Satan, and unseen conflict, but it refuses fear, obsession, and speculation. People may battle lies, temptation, accusation, fear, cravings, and destructive patterns.

Christ is supreme over every spiritual being and power. Jesus has won the decisive victory and equips His people with the armor of God. Believers stand in His victory through Scripture, prayer, faith, and the power of the Holy Spirit.

studySections.heading: Why This Matters
studySections.content:
Spiritual reality affects real life, but Scripture keeps the believer from fear and fascination. People may battle lies, temptation, accusation, fear, cravings, and destructive patterns. The unseen realm must be understood under the rule of God and the victory of Christ.

It also protects against spiritual confusion. Angels are servants, demons are defeated enemies, Satan is limited, and Christ alone is worthy of trust and worship.

studySections.heading: Discipleship and Application
studySections.content: Stand firm through Scripture, prayer, repentance, fellowship, and the Spirit’s power. Bring this doctrine into prayer, Scripture, and daily obedience. Ask the Holy Spirit to make the truth real in your thinking, desires, relationships, and next faithful step with Christ.
